result:the locally built archive and the downloaded published GitHub asset both have SHA-256 288781a7b6d40de2bc4b90191a2a4654b6e4890444f27ca3bf4647123ee080ad, matching the digest GitHub reports

content:hooks/module-insert.py in the package supports --proposal with the embedded preflight, the local-map equality check and the proof matcher self-check; proposal_promotion_proof.py exposes promotion_base
